title: SSC CPO Paper-1 Full Length Mock Test 16 (Hard Level)
description: Hard Level Full Length Mock Test for SSC CPO SI Paper-1. 100 questions covering Reasoning, GA, Quant and English as per latest pattern.
instructions: Yeh Hard Level Full Length Mock Test hai.
Total 100 questions: General Intelligence & Reasoning 25, General Knowledge & GA 25, Quantitative Aptitude 25, English Comprehension 25.
Har question 1 mark ka hai. Galat jawab par 0.25 marks katenge.
SSC CPO SI Paper-1 latest pattern ke anusar (condensed 100Q mock).

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If in a certain code, 'MANGO' is written as 'NBOHP', how is 'APPLE' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted +1: M+1=N, A+1=B, N+1=O, G+1=H, O+1=P. Similarly APPLE -> BQQMF.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a code language, 'DELHI' is written as 'EFMIJ'. How is 'MUMBAI' written?
questions.explanation: Each letter +1: D+1=E, E+1=F, L+1=M, H+1=I, I+1=J. MUMBAI: M+1=N, U+1=V, M+1=N, B+1=C, A+1=B, I+1=J → NVNCBJ.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Pointing to a lady, a man said, 'She is the daughter of the woman who is the mother of the husband of my mother.' How is the lady related to the man?
questions.explanation: Husband of my mother = father. Mother of father = grandmother. Daughter of grandmother = father's sister = aunt.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A is the brother of B. C is the sister of B. D is the father of A. How is C related to D?
questions.explanation: A and C are siblings, D is father of A, so D is also father of C. C is daughter of D.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: A man walks 5 km north, then 3 km east, then 5 km south. How far is he from the starting point?
questions.explanation: North 5, East 3, South 5 brings him to a point 3 km east of start.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: If South-East becomes North, North-East becomes West and so on, what will West become?
questions.explanation: The directions are rotated by 135 degrees clockwise or equivalent mapping. West becomes South-East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: All dogs are cats. Some cats are rats. Conclusions: I. Some dogs are rats. II. All rats are cats.
questions.explanation: Neither conclusion necessarily follows from the given statements.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: Statements: Some books are pens. All pens are papers. Conclusions: I. Some books are papers. II. Some papers are pens.
questions.explanation: Both conclusions follow.

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.subject: Reasoning

questions.explanation: Hands are at right angles twice between 4 and 5: approximately 4:38 and 4:43.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.question: In a class of 40 students, Ravi's rank is 15th from the top. What is his rank from the bottom?
questions.explanation: Rank from bottom = Total - Rank from top + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26.

questions.subject: Reasoning
